name: Coated Wafer Layers
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Hydrogenated vegetable fat, Refined wheat flour, Milk solids, Starch, Cocoa solids (4%*), Palmolein oil, Emulsifiers (442, 322, 476), Edible salt, Yeast, Raising agent (500(ii)), Improver (Enzyme). CONTAINS ADDED FLAVOUR (NATURAL, NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL (CARAMEL AND ETHYL VANILLIN) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES).
